text: Loads the specified labware with the given labels/slots and modules; suitable pipettes and tip racks.
PCR reactions for each fragment set up as specified (j5 primers 0.1 uM, 0.5 ng template, 25 uL), correct pairing of primers/templates to wells.
DpnI digestion of template and fragment clean-up/concentration steps carried out or recorded in order.
Fragments combined in the specified (length-proportional) volumes per assembly with BsaI-HFv2, T4 ligase and buffer; volumes match the task.
Golden Gate cycling program recorded/run as specified.
Assemblies cleaned up and transformed into TOP10 competent cells as specified.
Fresh tips between different fragments/assemblies; no cross-contamination.
Physically sensible: volumes within pipette limits, small volumes on the 20 uL pipette, operator pauses where manual steps are needed.
Consistent with the AssemblyTron paper where the task does not fix details; no invented, missing or reordered steps; comments/metadata accurate.
